blurb: Alfond Arena is Eaglebrook's hockey rink built in 1998. It provides ice time for multiple hockey teams for practices and games. The rink schedule includes free skating, learn to skate programs, Home Night activities, town skating, and school tournaments. Facilities include team locker rooms, a training room, and a snack bar. During fall, spring, and summer, an all-purpose surface is available for indoor sports, roller hockey, and rainy day activities.
